title: Kusanagi Nene — I'm Used To Setup Now〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Yawn*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm glad we're finally done shooting that film...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I'm still feeling pretty fatigued after working so late each day during that time...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
(I hope I don't fall asleep during class.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Morning, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Morning.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiraishi, Shinonome...
Morning.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Is it just me or do you sound kinda tired?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, you look a little paler than usual...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He's right. Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh...
Is it that obvious...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I feel a lot better now since it's over, but I was a little busy until just recently. I guess I'm still feeling a bit fatigued.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, are you talking about that film shoot?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh?! What film shoot?!
Like a real movie?! Not the one we made as a class?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
How did you know, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, I saw a certain someone spending a lot of time doing weird stuff in the courtyard. I'm guessing he was figuring out how to play his character.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, does that mean you were in it?
What did you play?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, we were just extras, so our characters didn't really have names. The shoot for our scene was over really quickly...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But we got to join the crew after that, which ended up being a lot of hard work...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! You guys got to be a part of both the cast and crew?! That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You've moved onto the real thing...
Filmmaking has sorta become a part of your life lately, huh?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Oh, you guys sound like you're having fun! What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kusanagi was just telling us about how she got to be in a real film and work as part of the crew!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: What?! A real one?!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: You were a part of the crew?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, um... I was only in it for a little bit, and I did get to help the crew out, but just with a bunch of minor things...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: That's still really cool!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Tell us more! What was it like working on a real film?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Was it pretty different from what we did?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Of course it was.
We're talking about real professionals here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Haha... Yeah, there were a lot of differences between what we did and how they handled things. The sheer size of the crew for one...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But despite those differences, I found them both good experiences in different ways.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: In different ways?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, for example... For the one I just worked on, everyone worked together really hard to make the director's ideas for it a reality.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: From the camera crew to the lighting techs, this group of professionals moved as a cohesive unit to make each scene just the way the director wanted.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Interesting...
So, what specifically did that involve?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Well...
For this one scene where a character takes a few seconds to eat something, everyone had to spend hours getting all the food and props ready...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hours?!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: For just that scene?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember thinking that that must be why the end product usually turns out so well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But when we made our film, it wasn't top-down like that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We brainstormed and discussed our ideas as a group, and it really felt like we made our film from complete scratch. I thought that was really fun...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: U-Uhh, sorry... I wasn't trying to sound preachy or anythi—

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, Kusanagi, that's a really nice thing to say!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It is?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Yeah! What you just said really hit home for me! I'm so glad you feel that way about what we did!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: If you feel that fondly about our film, then it means it was worth putting in all the effort we did!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-No, I was just...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But now I'm even more interested in this film you got to work on, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Me too. I still can't believe it took hours to shoot a scene that only lasted a few seconds.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
And you got to be in it, right?
I'm probably gonna cry like a baby when I see you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me too! I mean, how often do you get to see a friend in a real-life film?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Let us know when it releases!
I promise to go see it then!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, I'll let you all know when I hear about the release date...
